authorized_execution_only_change.description: Add a native prediction-only phase and graph-disabled pre-metric receipt so all eight predictions can be sealed before any target ground-truth open.
authorized_execution_only_change.prediction_only_behavior: After primitive unary and every target/stage score are persisted and hashed, atomically seal the receipt and return before the target-metric loop.
receipt_binds: primitive unary file and tensor SHA-256
every rendered target and stage-score SHA-256

batch_barrier.phase_1: Run all eight fixed commands with --prediction-only on physical GPU1 in scene order; no target ground truth is opened.
batch_barrier.phase_2_authorization: Only an eight-receipt batch authority with all hashes verified may authorize CPU scoring.
